home.title: YaldaTools — Free tools that run in your browser
home.description: Small, free tools with a retro look: QR codes, background removal and more. No sign-up, no ads, processed on your device.

qr.title: Free QR code generator: WiFi, URL, contact and WhatsApp — YaldaTools
qr.description: Create static QR codes that never expire for WiFi, links, contacts, WhatsApp and email. Colors, logo and PNG or SVG download, free and without sign-up.

removeBg.title: Remove image background for free, without uploading — YaldaTools
removeBg.description: Remove the background of your photos for free, in your browser: the image is never uploaded. Download a PNG with a transparent, white or colored background.

exif.title: Remove EXIF and GPS from photos for free, without uploading — YaldaTools
exif.description: See what your photo reveals (camera, date, GPS location) and remove it without losing quality. JPG, PNG and WebP, several at once, in your browser with no sign-up.

mergePdf.title: Merge PDF files for free, without uploading them — YaldaTools
mergePdf.description: Combine several PDFs into one and put the files in any order. Free, no sign-up and in your browser: your documents are never uploaded to a server.

support.title: Support the project — YaldaTools
support.description: YaldaTools is free and ad-free. Donations pay for the server and the time to build more tools.

readme.title: Readme.txt: about YaldaTools
readme.description: What YaldaTools is, how it protects your privacy, and credits for the illustration and libraries.

help.a: Data that the camera or phone stores inside the photo: model, date and time, settings and often the GPS location. You cannot see it in the picture, but it travels with it when you share it.
With the coordinates anyone can tell where the photo was taken: your home, your workplace or your children's school. Remove them before posting or selling something online.
No: nothing is recompressed. Only the data blocks are removed from the file; the pixels stay identical.
No. Everything happens in your browser and the status bar shows it: 0 bytes sent.
The color profile, so colors do not change, and the orientation, so the photo does not end up sideways.

help.a: It joins several PDFs into one, with the pages in the order of the list. Use Up and Down to change the order and Remove to leave a file out.
No. Everything happens in your browser and the status bar shows it: 0 bytes sent.
No: remove the password first. Protected or damaged PDFs are flagged in the list and left out of the merge.
Up to 100 MB per file and 300 MB in total, because the merge happens in your device's memory. If you have many large files, merge them in batches.
No. Pages are copied as they are, without compressing text or images again.
